title: Compactification comparison commutes with shifts
statement: The compactification comparison `compactificationComparison` of `lem-sf-native-weil-open-proper-forgetting` has a natural-transformation component that commutes with the integer shift on the ordinary derived categories, under the same separated, locally finite type and quasi-compact hypotheses as the item.

source.place: Native comparison Steps 8--9; the corresponding component of the item proof.

proof.text: Use the proved rightCompExactIso_shift, rightNatIso_shift, rightCompIso_shift and rightExactIso_shift helpers of CompactSupportIdentityCalculus for the four factors of the canonical proper comparison. The Grothendieck heart supplies exact integer coproducts, so forgetting preserves K-injectives. Expand only the ordered comparison and the isomorphism components. Exact derived composition and natural-isomorphism comparisons commute with shifts; closure under associators, whiskering, inverse and composition finishes.

theorem compactificationComparison_commShift
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] (c : Compactification f) :
    (compactificationComparison (k₀ := k₀) (l := l) f c).hom.CommShift ℤ
